boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Iowa State University
boards.description: Current, under-21-safe Ames and campus destinations with publicly posted late availability.

cards.title: Jeff's Pizza Shop
cards.subtitle: 2402 Lincoln Way, Ames
cards.notes: Plan a Thursday through Saturday pickup from this Lincoln Way shop; its official page lists service until 2:30 AM on those nights.
cards.short_summary: A Campustown-area pizza stop with the latest listed weekend hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Jeff's Pizza Shop lists Thursday–Saturday hours of 10:30 AM–2:30 AM at 2402 Lincoln Way in Ames.
cards.source_title: Jeff's Pizza Shop — Order Online
cards.access_notes: Officially listed hours are 10:30 AM–2:30 AM Thursday through Saturday; confirm before leaving, as hours can change.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Duff
cards.subtitle: 421 S Duff Avenue, Ames
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru option for a very late food stop; the official location page posts hours reaching 5:00 AM every day.
cards.short_summary: A Duff Avenue fast-food location with posted 5 AM drive-thru availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official Ames page lists drive-thru hours until 5:00 AM daily at 421 S Duff Avenue.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 421 S Duff Avenue, Ames
cards.access_notes: The official page lists drive-thru service until 5:00 AM daily; verify dine-in availability separately before going.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Lincoln Way
cards.subtitle: 620 Lincoln Way, Ames
cards.notes: Schedule a carryout or delivery order for a late Friday or Saturday; the location posts restaurant hours until 2:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: A Lincoln Way pizza option with posted 2 AM Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists hours until 2:00 AM on Friday and Saturday for its 620 Lincoln Way Ames location.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut — 620 Lincoln Way, Ames
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant hours run until 2:00 AM Friday and Saturday, and until midnight Sunday–Thursday; delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy's on South Duff
cards.subtitle: 528 S. Duff Avenue, Ames
cards.notes: Use this South Duff location for a late drive-thru or restaurant stop; its posted Friday and Saturday closing time is 1:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food option whose official hours extend to 1 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 1:00 AM Friday and Saturday at 528 S. Duff Avenue.
cards.source_title: Wendy's — 528 S. Duff Avenue, Ames
cards.access_notes: Officially listed restaurant and drive-thru hours are until 1:00 AM Friday and Saturday; other nights end at midnight.

cards.title: McDonald's on South Duff
cards.subtitle: 129 S Duff Avenue, Ames
cards.notes: Check the day before heading out: this official location listing shows 24-hour service Wednesday through Saturday and 1:00 AM on others.
cards.short_summary: A South Duff location with several officially posted 24-hour days.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists 24-hour restaurant and drive-thru operation Wednesday through Saturday at 129 S Duff Avenue.
cards.source_title: McDonald's — 129 S Duff Ave, Ames
cards.access_notes: The official listing shows 24-hour service Wednesday–Saturday; Monday, Tuesday, and Sunday list 1:00 AM closing. Recheck on holidays.

cards.title: Maverik on Welch Avenue
cards.subtitle: 203 Welch Avenue, Ames
cards.notes: For a Campus­town convenience stop, use the Welch Avenue store; its official page lists the store as open 24 hours every day.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience-store stop on Welch Avenue near Campustown.
cards.evidence_claim: Maverik #5028 at 203 Welch Avenue lists store hours as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Maverik #5028 — 203 Welch Ave, Ames
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists the store as open 24 hours every day; its page also identifies the 203 Welch Avenue address.

cards.title: Casey's on Lincoln Way
cards.subtitle: 428 Lincoln Way, Ames
cards.notes: Pick up snacks or a prepared-food order before midnight at this Lincoln Way convenience store; its official listing posts 11:30 PM pickup cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A convenience-store option with pickup and delivery posted until 11:30 PM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Casey's at 428 Lincoln Way lists store hours until midnight and pickup/delivery until 11:30 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Casey's — 428 Lincoln Way, Ames
cards.access_notes: Official listing: store open 5 AM–midnight daily; pickup and delivery run 5 AM–11:30 PM. The fuel pump is listed as 24/7.

cards.title: Pancheros on South Duff
cards.subtitle: 1310 S. Duff Avenue, Ames
cards.notes: Place a pickup or delivery order before the listed midnight close; the chain’s location finder identifies this Ames restaurant and its availability.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican-grill destination on South Duff with posted midnight service.
cards.evidence_claim: Pancheros lists its Ames restaurant at 1310 S. Duff Avenue as open until 12:00 AM and offering pickup and delivery.
cards.source_title: Pancheros Locations
cards.access_notes: The official Pancheros location finder lists the Ames restaurant as open until 12:00 AM and offering pickup and delivery; check same-day status.

cards.title: Domino's on Lincoln Way
cards.subtitle: 302 Lincoln Way, Ames
cards.notes: Use the official store page to place a carryout or delivery order; it currently shows this Ames location open until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Lincoln Way pizza chain location currently posting midnight availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official store page identifies the 302 Lincoln Way Ames location and currently displays service until 12:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Domino's — 302 Lincoln Way, Ames
cards.access_notes: The official store page currently displays “Open Today Until 12:00 AM”; Domino's notes that hours vary by location, so recheck before ordering.

cards.title: CyBowl & Billiards
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, Ground Floor
cards.notes: Make a Friday or Saturday campus stop for bowling, billiards, arcade games, or the Underground Cafe; posted hours run until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Memorial Union entertainment destination open to students and community members until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Iowa State lists CyBowl & Billiards in the Memorial Union with Friday and Saturday hours from noon to midnight.
cards.source_title: Iowa State Student Engagement — CyBowl & Billiards
cards.access_notes: Iowa State posts Friday and Saturday hours of noon–midnight. The page says break hours may change and advises contacting CyBowl to verify.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, documented study environments in Parks Library, with useful access and setup details.

cards.title: Learning Connections Center
cards.subtitle: First floor, Parks Library
cards.notes: Set up at wired wood tables for a group task, use the charging-ready workstations, or choose comfortable seating for an independent work block.
cards.short_summary: A bright, open work area with computers, tables, scanning, and varied seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Connections Center has 24 PCs, 12 Macs, wired study tables, charging-equipped workstations, scanning stations, and varied seating.
cards.source_title: Learning Connections Center | Iowa State University Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of Parks Library, north of the lobby beyond the glass wall.

cards.title: Central Parks
cards.subtitle: Learning Connections Center, first floor of Parks Library
cards.notes: Reserve a sound-dampening pod when a video call, interview, or concentrated solo task needs a private desk with power and USB ports.
cards.short_summary: Reservable booth-style pods designed for focused individual work and digital collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Central Parks has sound-dampening study pods with frosted-glass doors, height-adjustable desks, power outlets, USB ports, and Wi-Fi; an ADA-compliant pod is available.
cards.source_title: Central Parks offers booth-style study spaces including ADA-compliant option | Iowa State University Library
cards.access_notes: Anyone with an ISU NetID can reserve a pod for up to three hours; it is in the Learning Connections Center.

cards.title: Collaboration Corridor
cards.subtitle: First floor, Parks Library
cards.notes: Use the comfortable seating and large-monitor computers for a shared screen task, then move through the open corridor as your group’s needs change.
cards.short_summary: A non-reservable first-floor collaboration area with computers and flexible seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Collaboration Corridor offers modern study spaces, comfortable seating options, and computers with large monitors.
cards.source_title: Collaborative Spaces | Iowa State University Library
cards.access_notes: A non-reservable space on the first floor of Parks Library.

cards.title: The Glass Box
cards.subtitle: First floor, Parks Library
cards.notes: Bring a problem set or outline that benefits from writing things out, then use the whiteboard wall panels alongside the large cubicles.
cards.short_summary: Large cubicles with wall panels for visible, collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Glass Box has large cubicles, whiteboard wall panels, and a variety of comfortable seating.
cards.source_title: Collaborative Spaces | Iowa State University Library
cards.access_notes: A non-reservable space on the first floor of Parks Library.

cards.title: Study by the Cafe
cards.subtitle: First floor, Parks Library
cards.notes: Choose this café-style corridor when you want a table-style setup near Bookends Café while you read, write, or work through an assignment.
cards.short_summary: A cozy corridor with café-style seating beside Bookends Café.
cards.evidence_claim: Study by the Cafe is a first-floor Parks Library corridor with café-style seating near Bookends Café.
cards.source_title: Collaborative Spaces | Iowa State University Library
cards.access_notes: A non-reservable first-floor Parks Library space; café purchases are separate.

cards.title: Study Space by Stacks
cards.subtitle: Lower level and floors 2–3, Parks Library
cards.notes: Take a charging-ready table beside the stacks when you need to consult library materials and keep your notes or laptop close at hand.
cards.short_summary: Stack-side tables that pair charging access with nearby physical collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Space by Stacks provides tables with charging outlets along the stacks on the lower level and floors two and three; it is suited to quick material reference and small groups.
cards.source_title: Collaborative Spaces | Iowa State University Library
cards.access_notes: Non-reservable tables are available on the lower level and the second and third floors.

cards.title: Computer Stations
cards.subtitle: Floors 2–3, Parks Library
cards.notes: Use a dual-display station for work that needs a campus computer, then take advantage of the nearby printers for a fast print or scan step.
cards.short_summary: Dual-display computer desks positioned near printing services.
cards.evidence_claim: Computer Stations on the second and third floors have dual displays near printers, with armchairs nearby.
cards.source_title: Collaborative Spaces | Iowa State University Library
cards.access_notes: Non-reservable computer stations are located on the second and third floors of Parks Library.

cards.title: Open Study Area
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Parks Library
cards.notes: Spread out at a long table for group planning, use the whiteboards to map ideas, or select a height-adjustable desk along the south wall.
cards.short_summary: A large third-floor collaborative zone with whiteboards, charging, and adjustable desks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Open Study Area has long rectangular tables, charging outlets, whiteboards, and height-adjustable desks along its southern wall.
cards.source_title: Collaborative Spaces | Iowa State University Library
cards.access_notes: This is a non-reservable third-floor collaboration zone; the library identifies it as one of its noisiest study areas.

cards.title: Food-free Study Space
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Parks Library
cards.notes: Choose a curved couch or a rolling-chair table for a quieter work session, and plan to keep food outside this fourth-floor study area.
cards.short_summary: A quieter fourth-floor setting with couches and tables for individuals or groups.
cards.evidence_claim: The Food-free Study Space is a quieter fourth-floor area with curved couches and tables with rolling chairs for individual or group work.
cards.source_title: Collaborative Spaces | Iowa State University Library
cards.access_notes: A non-reservable, food-free study space on the fourth floor of Parks Library.

cards.title: Maps, Media, and Microforms
cards.subtitle: Room 2, lower level of Parks Library
cards.notes: Settle into the lower-level tables when you need a quieter base, then use the nearby rolling whiteboard, computers, scanners, or printers as needed.
cards.short_summary: A quieter lower-level study area with tables, media equipment, and scanning tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Maps, Media, and Microforms is a quieter lower-level study spot with group-study tables, a rolling whiteboard, computers, printers, scanners, and couches.
cards.source_title: Maps, Media, and Microforms | Iowa State University Library
cards.access_notes: Located in Room 2 on the lower level of Parks Library; the page lists fall-semester closing times through midnight Sunday–Thursday.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Iowa State University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A flexible, under-21-safe introduction to named campus places and low-pressure activities for a first weekend in Ames.

cards.title: Start with a campus question
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, ground floor
cards.notes: Pick up orientation help or ask for directions at the visitor center, then use the Memorial Union as your central-campus starting point.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a staffed campus waypoint before choosing the rest of the day.
cards.evidence_claim: The Memorial Union lists the Soults Family Visitor Center on its ground floor.
cards.source_title: Building Hours — Memorial Union
cards.access_notes: The published page lists the Visitor Center’s summer weekday hours; check the page for current availability.

cards.title: Find the Campanile
cards.subtitle: Central campus landmark
cards.notes: Use the Campanile as a visual meeting point, take a campus photo, and orient yourself to the central lawns before moving on.
cards.short_summary: A named landmark for a simple first campus rendezvous.
cards.evidence_claim: Iowa State’s official Art on Campus map identifies the Campanile on central campus.
cards.source_title: Art on Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; use normal campus pedestrian routes.

cards.title: Pause at the Four Seasons
cards.subtitle: Outside the Memorial Union
cards.notes: Make a short stop at the fountain outside the MU, then look for the four figures before continuing your central-campus walk.
cards.short_summary: A quick art-and-landmark stop beside the Union.
cards.evidence_claim: Iowa State’s catalog calls the Fountain of the Four Seasons an iconic campus landmark and places it at the Memorial Union.
cards.source_title: Student Life — Iowa State University Catalog
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public-art stop; no separate visitor process is stated on the cited page.

cards.title: Walk by Lake LaVerne
cards.subtitle: Central campus, near the Memorial Union
cards.notes: Take the paved campus route past Lake LaVerne and use the pause to compare landmarks you have already spotted with the campus map.
cards.short_summary: A named central-campus lake for a calm walking segment.
cards.evidence_claim: Iowa State’s official Art on Campus map labels Lake LaVerne near the Memorial Union.
cards.source_title: Art on Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Outdoor destination; follow posted campus guidance and stay on public paths.

cards.title: Settle in at Parks Library
cards.subtitle: Central campus library
cards.notes: Use the library as an indoor reset: locate the second-floor rotunda, check current access details, and plan the next stop with your group.
cards.short_summary: An indoor study-and-meetup stop on central campus.
cards.evidence_claim: University Museums identifies the second-floor Parks Library rotunda as an Art Walk starting location.
cards.source_title: Art Walk: Poetry Walk with Monday Monologues
cards.access_notes: Check University Library access and service information before relying on indoor spaces.

cards.title: Explore the sculpture garden
cards.subtitle: East and south of Morrill Hall
cards.notes: Walk through the garden at your own pace and look for Ghost Trees; the museum describes the sculptures as works visitors can walk within.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor art stop with a specific sculpture to locate.
cards.evidence_claim: University Museums places Tom Stancliffe’s Ghost Trees in the Anderson Sculpture Garden and says visitors may walk within the sculptures.
cards.source_title: Ghost Trees — University Museums
cards.access_notes: Outdoor sculpture garden; use public walkways and respect the artwork.

cards.title: Make time for the Gardens
cards.subtitle: 1407 University Boulevard
cards.notes: Bring your Iowa State student ID and allow time to explore the garden paths; confirm any special-event closures before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A botanical-garden visit that is free for Iowa State students.
cards.evidence_claim: Reiman Gardens states that Iowa State University students receive free admission and lists daily visitor hours.
cards.source_title: Admission and Hours — Reiman Gardens
cards.access_notes: Open daily 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; Tuesday and Thursday hours extend to 8 p.m. April 1–September 30. Check listed closures.

cards.title: Try a hands-on art session
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, east basement
cards.notes: Check the day’s drop-in craft or open-studio options at The Workspace, and choose a project only after confirming its materials and fee.
cards.short_summary: A campus art studio offering crafts, workshops, and open studios.
cards.evidence_claim: Iowa State’s catalog describes The Workspace as offering drop-in crafts, paint-your-own pottery, workshops, and open studios.
cards.source_title: Student Life — Iowa State University Catalog
cards.access_notes: The Memorial Union lists The Workspace in the east basement; published seasonal hours vary.

cards.title: Choose a low-key game
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, ground floor
cards.notes: If you want an evening activity, check in at CyBowl for bowling, billiards, arcade games, or table tennis and confirm availability first.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus recreation venue with several game options.
cards.evidence_claim: Iowa State’s catalog lists bowling, billiards, a video arcade, and table tennis at CyBowl & Billiards.
cards.source_title: Student Life — Iowa State University Catalog
cards.access_notes: The Memorial Union’s published summer schedule lists CyBowl noon–midnight Friday and Saturday; verify current hours before going.

cards.title: End with a quiet reset
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, room 4600
cards.notes: Wrap up by meeting in The Center for conversation or planning; its tables, seating, and study screens make it suited to a short regroup.
cards.short_summary: A Memorial Union lounge for relaxing, connecting, or group work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Memorial Union describes The Center as a lounge with seating, tables, study resources, and screens for students to plug into.
cards.source_title: Amenities and Lounge Spaces — Memorial Union
cards.access_notes: Located on floor 4 in room 4600; the published hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m., with after-hours access by request.
